request_semantics: Strict JSON + finite binary64; unique ordered IDs; all masses/scales/min_distance positive.
Derived force/velocity/mass/momentum/angular scales and reduced masses are finite strictly positive; reduced q/v/min_distance and dt are finite; nonzero-to-zero underflow is an explicit range error.

Every leg SI dt and its half, reduced dt and its half are positive representable; exact dt/factor retained when refining. Conservative arithmetic-domain restriction is declared, not universal physical necessity.

Initial and every force evaluation require all pair distances greater than minimum, AST value and first derivative defined and finite; drift-segment guard is additional. Checker does not execute arbitrary AST physics/domain evaluations.

payload_semantics.legs: Complete operation factors exactly[1] or[1,2,4] in order. Partial is nonempty prefix of started legs with valid initial force, no duplicates or invented unstarted leg.
payload_semantics.particle_arrays: particle_ids and masses exactly match request order; every q/v/F frame has shape[N,3]. No reordering or inferred entries.
payload_semantics.step_counts: leg.requested_steps=factor*primary_n; 0<=completed_steps<=requested_steps; full completion requires equality; aggregate tolerance failure may still have completed_steps=requested_steps.
payload_semantics.force_counts: force_evaluations counts attempted complete-force calls including failed calls; completed_force_evaluations counts calls returning valid q/U/F. Complete finite leg has both=n_leg+1. Partial leg has completed>=completed_steps+1 and attempted>=completed; driftguard failure may occur before next force call.
payload_semantics.frame_indices: For leg factor r, normal sample indices are r*j for primary j in{0,s,2s,...<n,n}, restricted to <=completed_steps. Append completed_steps if not already sampled for partial; reserve this terminal extra beforehand. Indices unique sorted, begin0, endcompleted_steps.
payload_semantics.times: frame.time_s equals correctly-rounded binary64(frame.step_index*exact_binary64(leg_dt)); same common nominal time in refinement; no interpolated or half-step frames.
payload_semantics.none_resolution: mode=none requires status=not_checked and both errors=null.
payload_semantics.refinement_resolution: Completed halving_2 has exactly3 complete legs and numeric coarse/fine errors; pass iff declared pass_rule. Incomplete refinement has status=not_checked and both errors=null. No successful output state on failed execution.
payload_semantics.status: execution/numerical/resolution/physical axes are in common result envelope; physical remainsunvalidated; successful phase state derives only from primary factor1 final frame.

state_semantics.time: data.time_s is scientific content; any later envelope physical_time must equal it exactly.
state_semantics.initial_only: Initial request requires0; evolving state schema permits nonnegative output times, but continuation not implemented.
state_semantics.integrity: IDs, masses, potential, scales and array ordering retain authored identity. Structural schema alone does not establish physical or temporal correctness.

execution: Only standalone velocity-Verlet request execution is supported. Generic workflow/API/UI integration, cross-module conversion and checkpoint restart remain unsupported. Initial validation alone is not a trajectory or numerical pass.
